title: Architectural Risk Auditing & System Stabilization
summary: Rapid 1-to-2 week intensive diagnostic audit analyzing database locks, query performance, security risks, and system crashes.

problem.headline: System Crashes & Unidentified Database Bottlenecks
points: Unexpected database deadlocks, memory leaks, and CPU spikes during traffic surges.
Internal teams trapped fighting daily fires rather than solving root causes.
Investors requiring technical due diligence before funding or acquisition.

approach.headline: Static Inspection & PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE Profiling
points: Profile query execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) and connection pool lock contention.
Audit security boundaries, session rotation, and payment outbox reliability.
Deliver a prioritized 30-day remediation matrix with exact code references.

deliverables: Blunt 20-Page Architectural Audit Report with code references
Executive Summary & Risk Scorecard for investors/CEOs
90-Minute Technical Debrief Session with engineering leads
